arguments.content:
-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv (code -> tier): A=gold, B=silver, C=bronze.

BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE customers
  ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

-- Any row whose legacy_code has no mapping in codes.csv keeps loyalty NULL.

COMMIT;
